paragraphs: SewerAI sells a platform for sewer inspection work, aimed at utilities, contractors and engineers. It covers the work from inspection through rehabilitation.

Its AutoCode product reviews every frame of CCTV footage, identifies NASSCO observations and assigns PACP, LACP or MACP codes automatically. The company says this runs on the CCTV equipment a crew already owns. PIONEER, the record-keeping side, brings inspection records, asset histories, maintenance logs and compliance documentation into one platform. It also builds capital plans, letting users lasso-select segments on a map and apply budget constraints and cost guidance.

The site says the platform is used by more than 2,000 cities nationwide. The company describes 400 years of combined experience pulling cable, running cameras and managing programs. Its detection draws on more than 425,000 NASSCO surveys and 40,000 manhole assessments. SewerAI states that it is SOC 2 Type II certified.
